subject: By-Election - Rosemont—La Petite-Patrie
precis: Order directing that a writ of election do issue in order to fill the vacancy in the House of Commons for the electoral district of Rosemont—La Petite-Patrie, in Quebec, with polling to take place on December 7, 2026.
